Case reference: 2014001522.CaseDesc: On July 7, 1977, James Stackhouse and a colleague were camped on a small island on the east shore of Lake Winnipeg, north of Hole River in Manitoba. Their vessel was drifting southwards, approaching Deer Island, which is situated 6 kilometres south of their current position. At approximately 6:00 p.m., the two men departed the shore, each holding onto small logs that had been tied together. They attempted to swim to Deer Island, but strong currents and waves carried them instead to a location east of Deer Island. The improvised raft constructed by the men was compromised, leading to their separation. The friend swam to Deer Island, but unfortunately James was not seen again. Extensive searches of the area were conducted using a variety of methods, including land, air, and water, but the body of James was not recovered.

Case reference: 2012020033.CaseDesc: On November 24, 1997, Daniel Gaulton and some friends walked into the Park Hotel in Grande Prairie, Alberta. He had called in to take the day off from his job as a security guard at a local construction site. Daniel withdrew cash from an ATM at 9 p.m. and returned home at 11 p.m.  He had a brief conversation with his roommate and left in his 1985 Chrysler LeBaron.

Tattoo: Left Upper Arm, Head of a black wolf on an orange moon

Case reference: 2014006175.CaseDesc: On July 8, 2013, at approximately 5:30 a.m., Jason Bathily and his twin sister, Clarene Bathily, were seen for the last time with their mother, Adelyne Mounga, in Toronto, Ontario.

Case reference: 2014004217.CaseDesc: On May 7, 1968, Bernice Redhead and her family were travelling on a dog sled led by their grandfather. The group was travelling on Gods River, Shamattawa, Manitoba, when they broke through the ice. All the passengers fell into the water. The grandfather managed to pull everyone to safety, except for Bernice, who was swept away by the river's fast-moving current. She has not been found to this day.

Case reference: 2014002960.CaseDesc: David Wycotte was last seen by his family on November 1, 1975, in Williams Lake, British Columbia. Up until December 1975, David was working in Winfield, British Columbia as a berry picker. David has been known to travel the area and the United States looking for labour jobs.

Case reference: 2022027245.CaseDesc: Anne Lenning was last seen in December, 1992, in Calgary, Alberta.

Case reference: 2010003099.CaseDesc: On July 23, 2010, OPP received a report that support cheques for Shelley Anderson of Cobalt Ontario, were returned uncashed for the past 12 months. Police attempted to locate her but were unsuccessful. She was last seen in the Haileybury and Cobalt area some time during the summer of 2009. Shelley also has ties to the Timmins and Schumacher areas, as she lived there for most of her life.

Case reference: 2014001088.CaseDesc: On September 13, 1973, the remains of an adult male were recovered from the Whirlpool of the Niagara River, in Niagara Falls. His post-mortem weight was recorded as being 165lbs, however, this measurement may not represent his actual living weight due to post-mortem changes noted at autopsy. His eye colour is believed to be brown. He was recovered without clothing.

Ring: Silver ring with a green stone on the third finger of his right hand
Watch: Cloth, Left wrist, had a red, yellow and blue watchstrap.
